newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FOCUS-BRAZIL B BAND SELLOFF TAKE $4.7 BLN SO FAR.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-BRAZIL B BAND SELLOFF TAKE $4.7 BLN SO FAR.

text.p: With five cellular concessions privatized, Brazil so far has drawn $4.71 billion in bids and is well on its way to surpassing its goal for its B Band frequency sale program.
The Brazilian government had set a base price of 3.69 billion reais ($3.4 billion) for 10 concession licenses, but later said it hoped to raise seven billion reais ($6.45 billion).
The big boost toward meeting that goal came July 9, when a group including BellSouth Corp won the lucrative Sao Paulo city concession with a spectacular 2.64 billion real ($2.45 billion) bid.

On Friday, Communications Ministry officials opened bids for two concession areas -- region No. 2 covering non- metropolitan Sao Paulo state and No. 10 comprised of six northeastern states -- bringing the total raised to 5.11 billion reais.
